title: Zacepene Citrusne Takania
description: This citrusy, crunchy Slovakian dish features cooking wine and tandoor to create an energizing snack, suitable for Jain followers.
instructions: Season Tandoori Chicken with Ginger Paste and Sesame Oil.
Place seasoned chicken in preheated tandoor for about 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
While chicken is cooking, mix Garlic Paste with Cooking Wine, Lemon Juice, and optional Citrus Zest to form a marinade.
Once chicken is done, remove from tandoor and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing into small pieces.
Drizzle the reserved marinade over sliced Tandoori Chicken.
Serve immediately as a snack or appetizer.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
